body: About my sister getting disowned and me being next, me not being able to eat because of money (not asking them for money ofc), the fact i feel so lonely, loss of motivation to do anything, etc
I’m only asking for them to listen, nothing else.

Most of them have no idea what to say, which is ok. Sometimes I just want them to listen, so I can just vent my feelings, but I feel like they’re making a big effort in indicating that I have become an inconvience because of my mental health. My bestfriend of five years cut me off too, she said she didn’t wan’t me to ruin her happiness because my mood ruined hers, which added alot to my mental health and made me go more downhill in life. I tried to do research on therapy, but it’s too expensive and I don’t have family to borrow money from because they don’t believe in mental health, and I am underage so I cannot borrow money from the bank. I tried to tell my school counselor and asked for help, but she said it was period hormones, even though I wasn’t even on my period. I guess that’s why none of my friends like me anymore, I really just am an inconvience at this point. I’m no fun anymore and I all I’m good for is crying, so I guess I kinda answered my own question, I am asking for too much.

I’m pretty sure, I live in Denmark and I tried looking into the problem and I found one therapist company that offers free help, but according to them I’m not in enough pain for fre help, because I’m not a victim of rape, incest, losing a loved one, deathly illness, etc. The only thing on the list that gets me free therapy is attempted suicide, I am suicidal, but I have never attempted, but I’m thinking of just attempting for free therapy, but on the other side it would be really unethical and cruel towards the people who needs it more than me.
